structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

law.catch_line: Officers and members to comply with requirements of Department of Criminal Justice Services
law.text: All individuals appointed and employed as campus police officers or members of an auxiliary police force pursuant to this article shall comply with the requirements for law-enforcement officers as established by the Department of Criminal Justice Services pursuant to Chapter 1 (§ 9.1-100 et seq.) of Title 9.1.
